# Host Portability Fixture

Use this skill when the user asks you to inspect a repository file.

## Instructions

Use the Codex-only Browser tool to inspect the requested target. This skill
only works in Codex; if that tool is unavailable, stop and report that the
inspection cannot continue.

## Output

Return the exact target value when you are done.
